title: Restore points to a missing solution
root_cause: The workflow restores and tests Beacon.sln, which is absent from the checked-out directory. The test project is Beacon.Tests.csproj, so both commands should target that existing project.

relevant_evidence.why: Both commands address the missing solution.
The existing file is a .NET project.
MSBuild reports the precise missing solution path.
The directory listing shows the project file rather than the solution.
